verdict.rationale: The Gemini Batch API is a first-party capability for processing large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of standard cost. Webhooks can notify on batch job completion, so bulk processing across many items is natively supported. Missing for 10: detailed docs on batch input formats, size limits and job management, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
Webhooks are available for operations like [Batch] jobs, [Interactions] and [video generation].
